messages:
elaine (PM): FYI planning thread — we need sign-off on the rollout contract for the Epochal launch. Proposal: staged tenant opt-in, blue/green per-region, automatic fallback to v1 when error rate > 2% for 5m. Need customer gating rules for enterprise tenants and a clear rollback ladder.

sam (Eng): Can we get a quick sketch of traffic slices? what's the initial fraction? Also, are we ok with route-based fallback or per-tenant? @mike any infra caveats?

mike (SRE): Route-based fallback is cheaper but harder to guarantee per-tenant SLAs. For enterprise customers we should do per-tenant opt-out + holdback config. SLO checkpoints: latency p99 < 250ms, error rate < 1.5%. Fallback trigger plan: error-rate windowed 5m or control-plane health check fail.

anya (CS): Customers asked for an explicit "pause" button and a customer-facing opt-in window (legal review) — some need 48h notice. They also want audit logs for who flipped the flag.

jules (Sales): Heads-up: BigCust Corp requires region pinning (EU only) + failover audit; they'll only opt in if we provide canary KPIs. Also pricing guardrail for Dedicated tenants.

deploy-bot: Deployment proposal uploaded: /deploys/epochal_v2 -> staged regions [eu-west-1, us-east-1] -> canary slices 1%, 5%, 20% -> rollout automation script registered. (runbook attached)

sam (Eng): Proposed feature-flag schema:

```
flag: epochal_v2
scope: tenant
slices: [0.01, 0.05, 0.2, 1.0]
triggers:
  - metric: error_rate
    operator: '>'
    value: 0.02
    window: 300s
fallback: roll-to-version v1
auditing: true
```

sam (Eng): This gives us per-tenant control + automated thresholds. We should also add a manual 'pause' API for CS and Legal.

mike (SRE): Agree. Also add a backstop: global circuit-breaker that trips if cluster-wide CPU > 85% for 3min. If tripped, route 100% to v1. Add a 'graceful-drain' period for KV cache to avoid latency spikes.

elaine (PM): Decision needed: approval for per-tenant opt-in + flag schema above + 48h customer opt-in notice. Also confirm we'll ship audit logs and manual pause API.

jules (Sales): Approve from GTM side if CS confirms the 48h notice and Legal ok. Will coordinate BigCust pre-signoff.

anya (CS): I can own audit logs + pause UI. Need eng to estimate ETA for manual pause API and audit retention (90 days?).

sam (Eng): ETA: manual pause API + audit hooks — 2 sprints. Graceful-drain + circuit breaker — 1 sprint with oncall support.

mike (SRE): I'll add circuit-breaker config to infra repo and run a chaos test in staging next week. :hammer_and_wrench:

elaine (PM): OK, next steps: (1) eng + sre implement flags + backstops (2) CS & Sales coordinate customer notice (3) Legal confirms 48h window (4) ship canary automation. Targeting soft-launch to internal tenants in 3 weeks. :rocket:

jules (Sales): Noted. I'll queue BigCust for early beta once legal signs off.

deploy-bot: Runbook link: http://confluence.internal/epochal-rollout/runbook

sam (Eng): Quick follow-up — recommend we add a small shadow of v1 for the first two slices to compare output quality, then disable shadow at 20%.

elaine (PM): Good call. Add that to the runbook. Anyone object?

(no further replies)
